# External evaluator, reproduction and adoption request for T190

BioInterfaceOS is requesting genuinely non-author participation for the current empirical candidate. This issue is a request for external work, not evidence that the work has already occurred.

Fixed public candidate:

- immutable tag: v0.1.3-r10
- exact commit: resolve with git rev-parse v0.1.3-r10
- packet: docs/external/R4_T191_EXTERNAL_EXECUTION_PACKET_20260814.md
- evaluator/reproduction protocol: docs/data/R4_T166_EXTERNAL_EVALUATOR_AND_REPRODUCTION_PROTOCOL.json
- adoption intake: docs/data/R4_T167_EXTERNAL_USER_ADOPTION_INTAKE.json

We are seeking:

1. one non-author evaluator who independently holds a protected held-out source or contributes an unseen real dataset for a one-time lockbox run;
2. one non-author team to reproduce the public PXD064962 route from the fixed checkout and raw public accession;
3. two non-author users or institutions to install the package and run distinct real tasks.

Every participant must disclose identity, institution, conflicts and scope. Reports must include the environment digest, commands, output hashes, deviations, failures and limitations. Protected row-level inputs and intermediate outputs must remain with the evaluator. The project will not count downloads, stars, page views, author-controlled reruns, fixtures or Codex agents.

Please open a response with the role you can perform. Do not attach protected row-level data to the public issue. The receipt schemas and private handoff route are described in the T166/T167/T172 files.
